sections.content: How many people stayed in Barrow upon Soar after gaining qualifications?

Barrow upon Soar is a small town in the East Midlands. Barrow upon Soar does not have its own university.

Barrow upon Soar has lower levels of deprivation.

Overall, Barrow upon Soar ended up with:

  • fewer graduates than it produced
  • fewer non-graduates with advanced qualifications than it produced
Note: all towns and cities in this analysis are defined based on population size only. This means that some cities are classed as towns because of their population.

Let's explore this further

There were 275 state-school pupils from Barrow upon Soar who sat their GCSEs between the 2007 to 2008 and the 2010 to 2011 school years.

Of these, 115 (42%) went on to gain degree-level qualifications (level 6+ as defined by The Office of Qualifications and Examinations Regulation, or Ofqual ). We will call these people graduates.

Another 75 (27%) went on to gain other advanced post-16 qualifications, such as A-Levels, a foundation degree or higher apprenticeship (levels 3-5 as defined by Ofqual). In this tool, we will refer to these non-graduates with advanced qualifications as “qualified non-graduates", for brevity.

The charts below compare Barrow upon Soar to other English towns and cities using three measures:

  • what proportion of Barrow upon Soar's pupils became graduates or qualified non-graduates by the 2017 to 2018 academic year
  • of those graduates and qualified non-graduates, the percentages that lived in Barrow upon Soar in the 2018 to 2019 academic year
  • how many graduates and qualified non-graduates from elsewhere came to live there by 2018 to 2019, relative to the number who sat their GCSEs there

In some towns, some of this information may not be available because of small sample sizes.
The size and deprivation level of a town, as well as the qualification levels of older residents, were all related to students' educational attainment. Read our previous analysis.

Where did those who left Barrow upon Soar move to?

Of Barrow upon Soar's graduates, 65 were living elsewhere in 2018/19.

However, 25 of those graduates (38%) were living fairly locally, in the Leicester travel to work area (TTWA).

Of Barrow upon Soar's qualified (level 3+) non-graduates, 35 were living elsewhere in 2018/19.

Of those in Barrow upon Soar's GCSE cohort:

  • 30 graduates left the East Midlands

In 2018 to 2019, 50% of graduates and 46% of qualified non-graduates living in Barrow upon Soar had moved there from elsewhere

In the 2018 to 2019 academic year, there were 100 graduates and 65 qualified (level 3+) non-graduates from our cohort living in Barrow upon Soar. This is compared with the 115 graduates and 75 qualified non-graduates who had lived there when they sat their GCSEs.

In 2018 to 2019, 50% of the graduates had also lived in Barrow upon Soar as GCSE pupils, while 50% had moved there from elsewhere.

Of the qualified non-graduates who lived in Barrow upon Soar in 2018 to 2019, 54% had lived there as GCSE pupils, while 46% had moved to the area from elsewhere.
